independent_computation.unknowns: The golden scenario's stat block (global ability haste) is defined under scripts/, which this oracle may not read. Ranks were taken from the corpus convention (S7): Q5 / W5 / E5 / R3.
independent_computation.identity: effective cooldown  c = cd_base * 100 / (100 + AH)   [S5]; solo-ability cast epochs = 0, c, 2c, ...  [S6]

haste_recovery.method: Solve for the single global ability haste AH that makes BOTH the old and the new leaf value exact cast epochs of Syndra's sourced ability set (Q 7s +30 haste from R3 [S2,S3], W 8s [S1], E 15s, R 80s [S4]). Swept AH over [0, 200] in 0.1 steps; epochs n*c for n<=11; tolerance 0.005 s.
haste_recovery.result: AH = 10 is the UNIQUE solution in the swept range (1 hit out of 2001 grid points).

independent_computation.value_derivation: New value: W 'Force of Will' rank 5, base cooldown 8 s [S1], hasted:  8 * 100/(100+10) = 7.27272... -> 7.27 at the snapshot's 2-decimal rounding. Its cast time is 'none' (0 s) [S1] and no other cast occupies t = 7.2727 (Q casts are instantaneous at 0/5/10; the only 0.25 s casts are E at 0 and 13.64 and R at 0 [S4]), so the shared-timeline mutual-exclusion rule [S6] leaves the epoch unshifted. Old value: 10.0 is ALSO an exact epoch of the same timeline — Q's third cast (2 * 5.0 = 10.0) — but it is the LATER of the two.
independent_computation.index_argument: damage_events is time-ordered. The leaf at a FIXED index 9 moved EARLIER (10.0 -> 7.27), which is only possible if at least one damage event was inserted at or before index 9; no removal can move an index earlier. The event now occupying index 9 carries a timestamp that is exactly Syndra's sourced W-recast epoch, and the event previously there (Q's third cast at 10.0) remains a valid later epoch. So the ledger gained the W recast (its damage row, or its 60-splinter bonus-true-damage row per S8) that the old ledger was missing between t = 0 and t = 10; nothing in the sourced data supports a ledger in which W, on an 8 s hasted cooldown, produces no damage event between 0 s and 10 s of a 'custom order' fight.
arithmetic_checks: 7 * 100 / 140 = 5.0 ; 2 * 5.0 = 10.0            (explains the old value as the next-later epoch)
At AH = 0 neither 7.27 nor 10.0 is any epoch of {7 or 5.3846 (Q), 8 (W), 15 (E), 80 (R)} — so the scenario carries haste, and AH = 10 is the only value reproducing both numbers.

verdict_rationale: 7.27 is reproduced to the last digit by the cached wiki cooldown for Force of Will at rank 5 (8 s, affectedByCdr true) under the engine's documented haste identity cd' = cd*100/(100+AH), at the same ability haste (10) that simultaneously explains the old 10.0 as Syndra's Q cast epoch (Q 7 s + R rank-3 passive 30 haste = 5.0 s cadence). Both timestamps are legitimate; the fixed-index leaf moved earlier because a damage event was added in [0, 7.27], and the timestamp it carries is exactly the sourced W recast. The new value is the correct content for index 9.
confidence: medium-high on the value (7.27 = 8*100/110 is exact and uniquely sourced); the ability-haste input (10) is recovered by a unique fit rather than read from the scenario definition, which lives under scripts/ and is out of bounds for this oracle.
caveats: The scenario's exact stat block, cast order, fight duration and item list were NOT read (scripts/ is out of bounds); ranks were taken from the corpus convention Q5/W5/E5/R3 and haste recovered by unique fit.
This oracle verifies the timestamp's provenance, not the identity/magnitude of the inserted damage event (no access to the event's other leaves).
